integrity: All proofs are analytical; the included reproducibility checks are finite and supplementary. Literature priority and scientific correctness remain open to independent review.
scientific_limitations: Vertex-source intrinsic Euclidean length metric on the complete regular cross-polytope surface; n=3 component follows from prior octahedron geodesic theory. The squared-excess law is not the full distance distribution. Literature coverage cannot establish absolute historical novelty.
title: An exact vertex-source geodesic law for cross-polytopes in all dimensions
